value.notes: First probe: check step, dash, dash recharge display, pause+move same tick (move should be ignored), resume. Next: check spikes, enemies, timer, gate/lever, pause-menu buttons, score cap.

Run 1 showed pause+left in the same tick still moved the player (ev=[pause,move,coin]). Design says pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored. Testing the shortest repro pause+right from (1,1) on seed 42. Expected P stays (1,1), buggy moves to (2,1). Budget is low, so after this confirm and finish.

Confirmed: a single tick 'pause+right' from a fresh game (seed 42) pauses the game (mode=paused, pause menu shown) but the player still moves from (1,1) to (2,1), with events [pause, move]. Design section 2 says pause takes effect immediately and the rest of that tick's input is ignored, so the player should stay at (1,1). Replayed from a fresh game, and the single-token form is already the shortest reproduction. Budget is nearly spent, so I am finishing here. Not explored: enemies, spikes, dashes, dialogs, and score caps.

reports.title: Movement key pressed in the same tick as pause still moves the player
reports.observed: Tick 'pause+right' from a fresh game: mode becomes paused (pause menu open), but the player moves (1,1) -> (2,1) and events are [pause, move]. The move is applied after the game has paused.
reports.expected: Pause takes effect immediately; the rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing else happens in that tick. The player should remain at (1,1) with no move event.
